cost_model.pnl_basis: modelled: every trade is a fixed notional of Rs 1,00,000 (capital per position) with no stop, with no limit on concurrent positions or total capital; net is after the modelled statutory charges and slippage

rows.title: Net expectancy at 1.0x cost
rows.threshold: >= +0.05R per trade
rows.evidence: the criterion is defined in R, the trade's own stop distance, and these trades have no stop; a stop-independent threshold has to be defined by the owner; measured net expectancy is +1610.36 bps over 301 trades

rows.title: Gross edge vs cost
rows.threshold: gross / cost >= 1.5 is comfortable
rows.evidence: gross 1634.36 bps against 24 bps round trip: comfortable

rows.title: Latency
rows.evidence: needs a delayed-entry rerun

rows.title: Bar resolution
rows.evidence: needs a pessimistic same-bar rerun

rows.title: Dispersion
rows.threshold: top 10 symbols <= 40% of net profit, >= 50% of symbols net positive
rows.evidence: top 10 symbols hold 37% of net profit; 79% of 99 symbols net positive

rows.title: Direction
rows.threshold: longs and shorts reported separately; a one-sided strategy is declared
rows.evidence: 301 long / 0 short trades; net +1610.4 bps long, n/a short; one-sided (long only)

rows.title: Survivorship
rows.threshold: report: the universe uses today's list, which is survivor-biased; test on symbols as they existed and list names that later left
rows.evidence: membership source current_symbol_master; survivorship bias True. The universe is today's symbol master applied to the past, not point-in-time membership: names that later left F&O or were delisted are absent and cannot be listed here because no historical membership source exists. Results are biased toward survivors

rows.title: Live caps applied

rows.evidence: 3 slots: net +1535.50 bps; 5 slots: net +2583.88 bps; 10 slots: net +1918.02 bps. The live max_open_positions is set in config.yaml and may not be among these

rows.title: Sizing
rows.evidence: a live-sizing check, not a trade-list one

rows.title: Capacity
rows.evidence: needs order size against bar volume

rows.title: Margin
rows.evidence: needs a simultaneous-margin model

rows.title: Chronological hold-out
rows.threshold: last 30% to 40% of sessions
rows.evidence: 33.3% of trade days held out from 2023-07-13; whether it stayed untouched until the candidate was frozen is not recorded

rows.title: Out-of-sample result
rows.threshold: OOS net > 0 and >= 40% of in-sample
rows.evidence: OOS +476.9 bps (92 trades) vs in-sample +2109.3 bps (209 trades)

rows.title: Walk-forward
rows.threshold: at least 4 rolling windows of 6 months; net above 0 in at least 60%
rows.evidence: 0 of 19 windows net positive (0 empty); shipped parameters held fixed in every window, so this is rolling stability, not a re-fit per window

rows.title: Symbol hold-out
rows.threshold: both symbol halves net > 0, weaker >= 40% of stronger
rows.evidence: half A +1633.7 bps (153 trades), half B +1586.3 bps (148 trades)

rows.title: Leakage and embargo
rows.threshold: no trade straddles the split; embargo of at least 1 session
rows.evidence: 30 trades straddled the cut and were purged from in-sample; embargo 1 session(s) removed 0 out-of-sample trades

rows.title: Cost model
rows.threshold: statutory charges at deployed notional plus slippage
rows.evidence: statutory schedule (CNC, NSE) priced per trade at the deployed notional (capital 100,000, risk 1.00% per trade, leverage 1x) plus 4 bps slippage per side: mean 30.25 bps against the engine's flat 24 bps

rows.title: Slippage stress
rows.threshold: net expectancy above 0 with slippage doubled (8 bps per side)
rows.evidence: net +1596.11 bps at 2.0x slippage (1.0x +1604.11 bps); total cost 30.25 bps at 1.0x, 34.25 bps at 1.5x, 38.25 bps at 2.0x

rows.title: Cost per trade in R
rows.threshold: median cost <= 0.40R
rows.evidence: the criterion is defined in R, the trade's own stop distance, and these trades have no stop; a stop-independent threshold has to be defined by the owner; median modelled cost is 24.00 bps of notional per trade

rows.title: Stop floor
rows.threshold: report: if a fixed floor sets most stops (more than 50% at one width), show results at other floors
rows.evidence: no accepted signals with a stop

rows.title: Sub-periods
rows.threshold: >= 60% of calendar years net positive, worst year >= -0.25R
rows.evidence: 9 of 10 years net positive; worst 2026 at -277.3 bps. The worst-year limit is an absolute number of R and these trades have no stop, so a stop-independent limit has to be defined by the owner

rows.title: Regime dispersion
rows.threshold: heuristic (calibrated): net positive in every sampled regime of each judged dimension
rows.evidence: no regime block supplied for this run

rows.title: Regime activation hypothesis
rows.threshold: hypothesis only; validate the filtered strategy out-of-sample
rows.evidence: no regime block supplied for this run

rows.title: Parameter perturbation
rows.evidence: needs a parameter sweep

rows.title: Trade count
rows.threshold: >= 200 net trades
rows.evidence: 301 trades

rows.title: Day-clustered t-statistic
rows.threshold: >= 2.50 at 1 trials
rows.evidence: day-clustered t 5.66 against the larger of the criteria level 2.50 and the record's Sidak hurdle 1.97

rows.title: Deflated Sharpe
rows.threshold: DSR >= 0.90 at the true trial count
rows.evidence: DSR 1.000 over 114 sessions at 1 trials (daily Sharpe 0.306 against a deflation threshold of 0.000); assumption: trial Sharpe variance is assumed to be the no-edge sampling variance, because only the trial count is recorded

rows.title: Probability of backtest overfitting
rows.evidence: needs P&L for every variant tried on a common grid; stats.pbo_cscv is implemented and waits for a parameter grid

rows.title: Trials ledger
rows.threshold: every variant tried is counted in trials.yaml; DSR and the t-hurdle use that count
rows.evidence: n_trials 1 from trials.yaml: 1 material and 0 external

rows.title: Dependence (Newey-West)
rows.threshold: t on daily aggregated P&L with a Newey-West autocorrelation adjustment
rows.evidence: Newey-West t 3.21 over 114 sessions (plain daily t 3.28); compare with the G2.2 bar, which the trade-clustered t already has to clear

rows.title: Track length
rows.threshold: sample length against the Minimum Track Record Length at 95 percent
rows.evidence: 114 sessions observed against a minimum of 10 sessions: sufficient

rows.title: Strategy parameter count
rows.threshold: fewer assumptions are better
rows.evidence: 4 strategy parameters

rows.title: Same logic in every mode
rows.evidence: code review and adapter tests

rows.title: Causality of every input
rows.threshold: a run on data cut at earlier sessions reproduces every earlier signal and trade
rows.evidence: 1 symbol(s) re-run at 1 cut(s): no earlier signal or trade changed

rows.title: Timestamps in IST
rows.threshold: all external times converted to IST at the boundary; bar timestamps are open-time
rows.evidence: stored as epoch seconds, converted to IST at load; all 5 ledger time columns are IST. open-time stamping is a property of each loader and is covered by its unit test, not re-proved per run

rows.title: Data coverage
rows.threshold: every symbol-session used has at least 370 one-minute bars (98.7% of a 375-bar session); gaps listed by name
rows.evidence: daily bars: one bar per session, so there is no intraday coverage to check

rows.title: No silent exclusion
rows.threshold: ledgers reconcile exactly; every exclusion carries a known reason code
rows.evidence: ledgers reconcile; exclusions by reason code: DIRECTION_DISABLED=336578, NOT_ELIGIBLE=4320, POSITION_OPEN=71850, WARMUP=51912

rows.title: Closing auction handled
rows.threshold: report: intraday level profiles use continuous-market bars only, stamped before 15:15
rows.evidence: data layer: only the 09:15-15:29 continuous session is kept; bars outside it, including any closing-auction prints, are dropped by the loader. Whether a feature or strategy reads bars from 15:15 onward is a property of its code (features/session.py), not checked per run

rows.title: Test quality
rows.evidence: pytest --cov

rows.title: Corporate actions
rows.threshold: report: split and bonus sessions excluded or adjusted; ex-date handling verified
rows.evidence: policy: intraday: sessions whose open versus previous close ratio lies outside 0.75 to 1.33 are excluded as probable splits; daily: back-adjusted for detected splits; dividends, bonuses and rights issues are NOT detected. This run excluded 0 symbol-sessions across 0 symbols as probable splits. Limits: the 0.75 to 1.33 test cannot see dividends, bonuses or rights, and ex-date handling is not verified, so this gate does not pass
